items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: I started playing with Jack. I played with Jack a very long time.

ctx.x: Oh, Conn. Yeah. They had a story.
I bought a tenor van jewel. It cost $150 there. And learned that the first band that I started playing with when I bought the van jewel, it was Jack Carrey's band.
Oh, yeah. I knew his brother Mutt, but I never knew Jack Carrey.

items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: And Cafferys' uncle, he was a trombone player.

ctx.x: Yeah. Same family and all that. That's it.
And Cafferys' uncle, he was a trombone player.
